why: The modes of ending the employment relationship (resignation, dismissal, retirement, end of a fixed-term contract), to tell a dismissal from other endings in boundary n3; only articles 1, 2, 3, 73 to 73-4, 80 and 88 of law 90-11 are in the store.
Dismissal for economic reasons (reduction of staff) and its procedure, with 70 and 71, to bound the claim against economic dismissal (boundary n3).
Reduction of staff, read with 69 and 71, for boundary n3.
Reduction of staff, read with 69 and 70, for boundary n3.
The cases where a fixed-term contract is allowed, and with article 14 the requalification as an indefinite contract, to tell the end of a fixed-term contract from a dismissal (boundary n3).
A fixed-term contract concluded in breach of the law deemed indefinite, read with article 12, for boundary n3.
How the employment relationship is proved (element e1).
The categories of workers under special provisions besides article 3, to bound who may bring the claim.

From memory, law 90-14 on the exercise of union rights (articles 53 to 56) protects union delegates against dismissal (nullity and reinstatement); a boundary or rule of this record would cite it (open point o4).
